name: code-block
title: Code Block
description: A shared code surface with exact-source copying, animated format changes, optional line numbers, highlighted lines, wrapping and native scrolling. Code remains selectable and the surrounding layout follows content height.
example:
<CodeBlock code={source} label="theme.css" language="CSS"
  lineNumbers highlightedLines={[2, 3]} wrap maxHeight={280}
  onCopy={notify} />

<CodeBlock examples={commands} label="Install"
  value={format} onValueChange={setFormat} />
